messages:
Maya: Quick sync — tonight's 6:30pm PT demo for EU/APAC. Need to confirm reg page gating, Zoom greenroom keys, recording split for clips, and postcard follow-up. Who's on for ops?

Brian: I'm on. Zoom config ready. meeting id `987654321`, passcode `redwood-demo`. I'll hand host to greenroom engineer at 6:10pm. Disable waiting room per request? :thinking: 

Toni: Leave waiting room off, we want instant join for presenters. I'll enable cloud recording (separate audio) + SRT for caption capture. Split recording into slides/audio via `archive_split=true` flag in the meeting settings.

Maya: Good. Toni, can you also ensure thumbnail snapshots every 60s? We use for clip thumbnails.

Toni: Yep. Set `thumbnail_interval=60s`. Also adding a 1GB-per-hour cap to avoid runaway storage.

Evan: On lead flow: Zapier -> HubSpot mapping ready. Zap: `webinar_registered` -> create/update contact, set lifecycle stage `lead`, add list `evening-demo-apac`. Assign owner to `growth-team@redwood.com` if company size > 50.

Sarah: Postcard (email) draft is up in Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/evening-demo-postcard. CTA: 'Watch highlights' link to mini-replay + CTA to book a 1:1. Send at +2 hours after demo. A/B test subject lines (short vs benefit).

Maya: Love that. Add a quick plain-text fallback for clients that block images.

Evan: Also planning flow for no-shows: at +6 hours send highlight clips and 'missed you' reminder, tag as `no_show`. Also push attended vs no-show to SFDC via webhook `POST /webhooks/webinar_event`.

DeployBot: Zoom scheduled by @Brian. Meeting link: https://zoom.us/j/987654321 Passcode set. Reminder set for 15m before start.

Brian: Will upload greenroom notes to the meeting description and pin host key to 1Password `teams/greenroom/evening-demo`.

Maya: Last preflight checklist: 1) reg page final text, 2) confirm SRT captions, 3) postcard copy in HubSpot, 4) greenroom keys in 1P, 5) test replay S3 lifecycle. Can everyone react with :white_check_mark: when done?

Toni: :white_check_mark:

Evan: :white_check_mark:

Sarah: almost — finishing A/B variants, will mark in 10m :soon:

Maya: Thanks — put any last-minute ops notes in this thread. I'll do a 6:05PM ping.
